quotes.title: GJ 3470
quotes.card: GJ 3470, proper name Kaewkosin, is a red dwarf star located in the constellation of Cancer, 96 light-years away from Earth.
quotes.introduction: With a faint apparent magnitude of 12.3, it is not visible to the naked eye.
